notes: Read SKILL.md (343 lines) in full; it is the only file in source. Guidance and C# samples for Azure.ResourceManager.BotService: create/update/delete Azure Bot resources, configure DirectLine/Teams/Web Chat channels, list channels, and regenerate DirectLine keys.

Tells the agent to run `dotnet add package` for official Azure packages (SKILL.md:19-20, also listed with Microsoft.Bot.Builder at SKILL.md:332-334) and uses the developer's real Azure credentials to create, update, delete, and regenerate keys on ARM resources (SKILL.md:95, 213, 233, 240). The agent itself does not handle real secrets: credential and service calls live in sample code for the user's application. Medium for package installs and state-changing live-cloud operations; acceptable because packages are official and operations target the user's own subscription for the requested task.

Regenerating DirectLine keys (SKILL.md:208-213) invalidates existing client keys and DeleteAsync (SKILL.md:240) removes the bot; neither is gated in the sample, so agents should confirm with the user before running them against real resources.
